equation_request.abstract: Nonlocal properties of an ensemble of diagonal random unitary matrices of order $N^{2}$ are investigated. The average Schmidt strength of such a bipartite diagonal quantum gate is shown to scale as $\log N$, in contrast to the $\log N^{2}$ behavior characteristic to random unitary gates. Entangling power of a diagonal gate $U$ is related to the von Neumann entropy of an auxiliary quantum state $\rho=AA^{\dagger}/N^{2}$, where the square matrix $A$ is obtained by reshaping the vector of diagonal elements of $U$ of length $N^{2}$ into a square matrix of order $N$. This fact provides a motivation to study the ensemble of non-hermitian unimodular matrices $A$, with all entries of the same modulus and random phases and the ensemble of quantum states $\rho$, such that all their diagonal entries are equal to $1/N$. Such a state is contradiagonal with respect to the computational basis, in sense that among all unitary equivalent states it maximizes the entropy copied to the environment due to the coarse graining process. The first four moments of the squared singular values of the unimodular ensemble are derived, based on which we conjecture a connection to a recently studied combinatorial object called the “Borel triangle”. This allows us to find exactly the mean von Neumann entropy for random phase density matrices and the average entanglement for the corresponding ensemble of bipartite pure states.

specification.problem: For a diagonal unitary U=sum_{jk} exp(i phi_jk)|jk><jk| on two n-qubit registers (N=2^n), prepare |psi>=U(H^{\otimes 2n}|0>) and obtain the von Neumann entropy S(rho) of rho=AA^dagger/N^2, where A is the N x N unimodular matrix of phases. This entropy is the entanglement of |psi> and is related to the entangling power and operator Schmidt strength of U. Then average over random phase draws.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Tiny instance n=2 (4 qubits, no ancillas) with i.i.d. uniform phases, statevector simulation, no measurements. Entropy is computed classically from the reshaped amplitude matrix. The swap-test purity estimate (4n+1 qubits) is an optional extension. Analytic moment derivations, the Borel triangle conjecture, and the exact mean entropy formula are outside the scope; they appear only as classical comparison targets that are not specified here.

symbols.domain: power of two, N=4 for the tiny instance

symbols.meaning: N x N matrix with A_{jk}=e^{i\phi_{jk}}, reshaped diagonal of U
Auxiliary state AA^\dagger/N^2, equal to the reduced state of A in |\psi>
symbols.domain: density matrices of dimension N, trace 1

symbols.meaning: Eigenvalues of rho, i.e. squared singular values of A/N

equations.label: Diagonal gate
equations.description: Random-phase diagonal gate on registers A and B. The N^2 diagonal entries reshape into the matrix A.
equations.abstract_quote: reshaping the vector of diagonal elements of $U$ of length $N^{2}$ into a square matrix of order $N$
equations.justification: The abstract describes diagonal random unitaries of order N^2 with random phases, so the diagonal entries are unit-modulus phases.

equations.label: Prepared state
equations.description: Applying U to |+>^{2n} gives a pure bipartite state whose coefficient matrix is A/N.
equations.justification: Proposed construction from the sketch. It is a direct calculation, not a statement in the abstract.
assumptions: register A holds j, register B holds k
Qiskit little-endian: A qubits are the low n qubits unless reordered
reshape index = j*N+k with j the A index

equations.label: Reduced state
equations.description: The reduced state on A has all diagonal entries equal to 1/N. This is the contradiagonal property.
equations.justification: The abstract states the form of rho and that its diagonal entries are all 1/N. The diagonal value follows from unimodularity: (AA^\dagger)_{jj}=N.

equations.label: Entropy readout
equations.description: The entanglement of |psi> and the entropy relevant to the entangling power of U are read from the singular values of the reshaped statevector matrix.
equations.abstract_quote: Entangling power of a diagonal gate $U$ is related to the von Neumann entropy of an auxiliary quantum state
equations.justification: The abstract relates entangling power to S(rho). The exact proportionality constant is not given, so only S is computed.

equations.label: Purity and moment
equations.description: The purity is the second moment of the squared singular values. It can be estimated with a swap test on two copies, and is a classical check from the statevector.
equations.justification: Standard definition. The abstract mentions moments but does not give formulas for them.

equations.label: Ensemble mean
equations.description: Monte Carlo mean entropy over M independent phase draws. It is compared with the analytic prediction, which is not specified here.
equations.justification: A numerical estimator, not given in the abstract.

registers.name: A
registers.size: n qubits (2 for the tiny instance)

registers.name: B
registers.size: n qubits (2 for the tiny instance)

registers.name: anc
registers.size: 0 (optional n for a copy of B; 4n+1 total for a two-copy swap test)
registers.role: optional, only for the swap-test extension

steps.description: Apply H to every qubit of A and B.
Apply the diagonal gate with the sampled phases, built from standard gates (e.g. Qiskit Diagonal or phase and controlled-phase gates), with no black box and no measurements.
Read the statevector and reshape it into an N x N matrix, then compute the singular values and S. Optionally check purity.
Repeat over many draws and average.

specification.measurement: None for the statevector route. The swap-test extension would measure one ancilla.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Reshape the statevector into a matrix M with M[j,k]=amplitude of index k*N+j under Qiskit's little-endian ordering with A on the low qubits. Use the SVD, set lambda_i to the squared singular values, and compute S, Tr rho^2, and the average over draws.
assumptions: Natural log is used for entropy.
Moment and Borel triangle predictions are for classical comparison only.
missing_information: Exact formulas for the first four moments and the Borel triangle connection are not in the abstract.
The exact mean entropy formula is not in the abstract.
The proportionality between entangling power and S is not given.
Schmidt strength scaling constants are not given.
